args.message:
Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity:
unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays). Versions
<2.9.4 are affected; 2.9.4 contains the fix. Staying on the 2.x
line to avoid the breaking changes in the 3.x major series.

args.body:
## Summary
- Upgrades `fastjson` from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in `requirements.txt`.

## Why
fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. All versions <2.9.4 are affected; 2.9.4 contains the fix. I stayed on the 2.x line to avoid the breaking changes in the 3.x major series.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit c8b8ab7878: **passed**.
